note: Hand-maintained. One entry per component the page runtime registers, and the sync script (scripts/sync-nuxt-ui-docs.ts) fails when that stops being true. This is the CHOICE half of the component docs — what each one is for, and what it is not for. The API half is generated per component from the library's own docs and served by pageDocs. Keep every line short: the whole file is rendered into the builder's cached prompt prefix, so a paragraph here is paid on every build. `job` groups the render; `not` is only written where the confusion is real; `why` replaces when/not for a component the page frame cannot run.

jobs.feedback: tell the reader what is happening
jobs.excluded: registered, but the page frame cannot run it

Accordion.what: stacked sections that open one at a time
Accordion.when: grouped detail the reader opens on demand, in order
Accordion.not: peer views of one subject (UTabs) or a single block (UCollapsible)

Alert.what: a message that stays on the page
Alert.when: a condition the reader must keep seeing: a failed dataset, a stale figure
Alert.not: confirmation of something they just did (`useToast()`)

App.why: already mounted around your page — a second one double-mounts overlays and toasts

AuthForm.what: a sign-in form with fields, providers and validation
AuthForm.when: a page whose subject is credentials — rare
AuthForm.not: signing into Fretik: the app owns that, a page is already authenticated

Avatar.what: one person or thing, as an image or initials

AvatarGroup.what: several avatars stacked, with an overflow count
AvatarGroup.when: who is on this, in one cell

Badge.when: one categorical value, read at a glance
Badge.not: prose, a number worth reading, or every field of a row
Badge.distinctive: `variant="subtle"` for data, `solid` for the one that leads

Banner.what: a strip across the very top of the page
Banner.when: one page-wide condition above everything else
Banner.distinctive: never pass `id` — with one it reads localStorage and writes to `<head>`, and the frame has neither

BlogPost.what: one article card: image, date, authors, badge
BlogPost.when: an item whose subject really is an article or a post

BlogPosts.when: the set is articles and the image carries meaning
BlogPosts.not: business records with an image field — that is UPageGrid or UTable

Breadcrumb.what: the trail back up a hierarchy
Breadcrumb.when: a view reached from another one — a detail, a nested list

Button.when: anything the reader clicks to make something happen

Calendar.what: a month grid the reader browses
Calendar.when: the subject IS dates — availability, load per day, what falls on the 12th
Calendar.not: picking a date in a form (UInputDate)
Calendar.distinctive: values are `@internationalized/date`, never `Date`; `#day` carries your own content

Card.what: a bordered unit with header, body and footer
Card.when: content that could move elsewhere whole
Card.not: every region of a page — a heading and spacing group just as well, and a page of cards has no hierarchy

Carousel.what: one item at a time, swiped
Carousel.when: images the reader browses without comparing
Carousel.not: data — a carousel hides everything it is not showing

ChangelogVersion.what: one dated entry with title, description and body
ChangelogVersion.when: an item on a release or history rail

ChangelogVersions.what: dated entries down an indicator rail
ChangelogVersions.when: releases, audits, decisions — a history the reader scrolls
ChangelogVersions.not: short events with no body (UTimeline is denser)

ChatMessage.what: one message with avatar, actions and its own side
ChatMessage.when: any exchange: a mailbox, a ticket thread, comments on a record

ChatMessages.what: a scrolling thread that sticks to the bottom
ChatMessages.when: the page is a conversation, not a list of texts

ChatPalette.what: a chat laid out for an overlay
ChatPalette.when: a thread inside a UModal or USlideover

ChatPrompt.what: the composer: autoresizing textarea plus a toolbar
ChatPrompt.when: the reader writes into a thread

ChatPromptSubmit.what: the send button that knows the stream's status

ChatReasoning.what: a collapsible block of intermediate thinking
ChatReasoning.when: showing how an answer was reached

ChatShimmer.what: text that shimmers while it is being produced
ChatShimmer.distinctive: put the pending text in the default slot

ChatTool.what: one step of work, with its state and result
ChatTool.when: showing what a process did, step by step

Checkbox.when: a single yes/no the reader ticks
Checkbox.not: a setting that takes effect immediately (USwitch)

CheckboxGroup.what: several choices from a list, all visible
CheckboxGroup.when: a filter over a handful of known values

Chip.what: a dot or count on the corner of something else
Chip.when: unread, pending, needs-attention on an avatar or a button

Collapsible.what: one block that opens and closes
Collapsible.when: detail that would crowd the screen but must stay reachable
Collapsible.distinctive: `#content`; the trigger is the default slot

ColorPicker.what: a colour, as hex, rgb or hsl
ColorPicker.when: the reader chooses a colour that is data

CommandPalette.when: a mini-app with more views or records than a menu can hold

Container.when: prose or a form that must not run the whole width
Container.not: a table or a board — those want the frame
Container.distinctive: one class does the same; use it when the cap repeats

ContextMenu.what: the verbs of an item, on right-click
ContextMenu.when: a dense list where a visible button per row would be noise
ContextMenu.not: the only way to reach an action — it is invisible until tried
ContextMenu.distinctive: wraps the target; `items` as nested arrays for groups

DashboardGroup.why: the app's dashboard shell — it calls Nuxt hooks and persists in a cookie the frame has none of

DashboardNavbar.why: the app already draws the bar above your page; alone it has no group to answer to

DashboardPanel.why: persists its size in a cookie the frame has none of; USplitter is the resizable split that works here

DashboardResizeHandle.why: belongs to UDashboardPanel; measured 0px wide inside a page

DashboardSearch.why: wired to the app's own command palette and shortcuts

DashboardSearchButton.why: opens the app's search, which the frame cannot reach

DashboardSidebar.why: the app's sidebar, cookie-persisted; USidebar or UPage + UPageAside is the rail that works in a page

DashboardSidebarCollapse.why: toggles the app's sidebar, not yours

DashboardSidebarToggle.why: toggles the app's sidebar, not yours

DashboardToolbar.why: belongs to the app's dashboard shell; a plain flex row is the toolbar of a page

Drawer.what: a sheet that rises from an edge, dragged
Drawer.when: a touch-first choice or a quick action sheet
Drawer.not: a long form — the panel is short by design

DropdownMenu.what: the verbs of one item, under a trigger
DropdownMenu.when: a row or a card has more than two actions
DropdownMenu.distinctive: default slot is the TRIGGER; `items` as nested arrays for groups

Editor.when: text written to be read formatted — a note, a message, a description

EditorDragHandle.when: the reader rearranges a long document

EditorMentionMenu.when: writing that points at people or records

EditorSuggestionMenu.when: a document where blocks are inserted by name

EditorToolbar.what: the formatting bar, fixed, floating or bubble
EditorToolbar.when: beside a UEditor the reader writes in

Empty.what: the state where there is nothing yet
Empty.distinctive: `title` says what is missing, `description` and `#actions` say what to do

FieldGroup.when: an input and its button, a segmented row
FieldGroup.distinctive: `size` and `orientation` apply to the whole group

FileUpload.what: a drop area or a button that takes files
FileUpload.when: the reader adds a file from the page

Footer.why: the app frames your page; a second footer inside it reads as a bug

FooterColumns.why: link columns for a marketing footer the page does not own

Form.what: validation, error placement and submit for a set of fields
Form.when: anything the reader fills in and sends
Form.distinctive: `:validate` returns the errors — no schema library ships in the frame; `@submit`, `.validate()`

FormField.what: label, description, hint and error around one input
FormField.not: filters above a table — those are controls in a toolbar, not a form
FormField.distinctive: `name` links it to the error UForm reports

Header.why: the app draws the header above your page

Icon.when: an icon that carries meaning, never as decoration on every label
Icon.distinctive: `i-lucide-*` only, written literally — a name built at runtime renders blank

Input.when: free text, a search box, an email

InputDate.what: a date or a range, with a calendar
InputDate.when: the reader picks a day in a form or a filter

InputMenu.what: type freely and pick from suggestions
InputMenu.when: the value may exist or may be new
InputMenu.distinctive: `create-item` turns typing into a new value

InputNumber.when: a quantity with a min, a max or a step

InputRating.when: reading a rating (`disabled`) or asking for one
InputRating.distinctive: `disabled` makes it a display; `#item` for a custom mark

InputTime.when: a time of day, beside a date

Kbd.when: a page that has shortcuts — say so where the action is

Link.what: one link, with an active state
Link.when: moving between views of this page (`to="/deal/12"`)
Link.distinctive: `active-class`, `exact`; renders a plain `<a>` when `to` is external

Listbox.what: a list, always visible, that the reader picks from
Listbox.when: a choice that stays on screen beside what it filters
Listbox.not: a value hidden behind a trigger (USelectMenu)

Main.why: the app's main region already contains your page

Marquee.when: a ticker of live values along one edge
Marquee.not: anything the reader must read carefully

Modal.what: an interruption the reader must finish or cancel
Modal.when: a destructive confirmation, a decision that cannot be half-made
Modal.not: showing detail, or any long task — those are a view or a slideover
Modal.distinctive: default slot is the TRIGGER, the panel is `#body`; `dismissible=false`

NavigationMenu.what: the menu of a mini-app, horizontal or vertical
NavigationMenu.when: the page has views and the reader must see which one they are on
NavigationMenu.distinctive: `items` with `to`, `orientation`, `highlight`; active state comes from the route

Page.what: a body with optional left and right columns
Page.when: a layout with a rail — filters on one side, content in the middle
Page.distinctive: `#left` / `#right` take a UPageAside; the default slot is the body

PageAnchors.what: a short list of jump links
PageAnchors.when: a long report the reader navigates by section

PageAside.what: a sticky rail that scrolls with the reader
PageAside.when: filters, a summary or a table of contents that must stay put
PageAside.distinctive: goes in UPage's `#left`/`#right`; sticky from `lg` up, stacked below

PageBody.what: the padded main column inside UPage
PageBody.distinctive: spacing only — no border, no background

PageCTA.what: a band that asks for one action
PageCTA.when: the end of a report, where the reader decides what to do next

PageCard.what: a card with icon, badge, highlight and links
PageCard.when: a grid of things that each open somewhere
PageCard.not: a plain container (UCard) — this one has an opinion
PageCard.distinctive: `to` makes the whole card the target; `highlight`, `spotlight`, `reverse`

PageColumns.what: a masonry flow of uneven children
PageColumns.when: cards of different heights that must not leave gaps
PageColumns.distinctive: children flow between columns; a grid keeps rows aligned instead

PageFeature.when: explaining a capability inside a UPageSection
PageFeature.distinctive: `to` makes it a link; used through UPageSection's `features`

PageGrid.when: few items, each visual or with its own actions
PageGrid.distinctive: wraps UPageCard children and fixes the columns

PageHeader.what: a title, a description and the page's actions
PageHeader.when: the top of a view, when plain markup would repeat

PageHero.what: an opening band: title, description, links, media
PageHero.when: a report or a briefing whose first screen is a statement
PageHero.not: a working screen — the answer belongs above the fold, not a headline about it

PageLinks.what: a labelled list of related links
PageLinks.when: sources, related records, what to read next

PageList.what: a vertical list of rich items
PageList.when: items with two lines and a thumbnail, read one by one
PageList.not: values the reader compares column by column (UTable)

PageLogos.what: a row of logos or marks
PageLogos.when: the sources or partners behind a report

PageSection.what: a full-width band with a headline and a feature grid
PageSection.when: a report's chapters, where each one makes one point
PageSection.not: a region of a working screen — it is sized for reading, not for scanning

Pagination.when: the dataset reports more rows than one screen holds
Pagination.distinctive: `total`, `items-per-page`, `sibling-count`; feed the page back into the query

PinInput.what: a fixed-length code, one box per character
PinInput.when: a short code the reader types from somewhere else

Popover.what: a small block anchored to what opened it
Popover.when: a definition, a mini-form, a filter that fits in a corner
Popover.distinctive: default slot is the TRIGGER, the block is `#content`; `mode="hover"`

PricingPlan.what: one offer: price, terms, features, button
PricingPlan.when: the subject is what something costs

PricingTable.when: the comparison is per feature, not per price
PricingTable.distinctive: `sections` with per-tier values; a UTable when the columns are data

Progress.when: completeness of a record, a quota, work done
Progress.distinctive: `:model-value="null"` is indeterminate; `size="xs"` fits inside a row

ProgressGroup.what: one total split into named parts, with a legend
ProgressGroup.when: a breakdown of a whole — before reaching for a pie
ProgressGroup.distinctive: `items` with value, label and colour; `status` prints them

RadioGroup.what: one choice from a few, all visible
RadioGroup.distinctive: `variant="card|table"` when each option needs a description

ScrollArea.what: a scrolling region with a styled bar
ScrollArea.when: a bounded region whose scrollbar would otherwise be invisible or ugly
ScrollArea.distinctive: the region still needs a height; `type="hover"`

Select.what: a short fixed list behind a trigger
Select.when: status, role, currency — values the reader knows by name

SelectMenu.what: a searchable list, single or multiple
SelectMenu.when: the list is long, grouped, or picked from more than once

Separator.what: a divider, optionally carrying a label
Separator.when: a break inside one region that headings would over-state

Sidebar.what: a standalone rail with a header, a body and a footer
Sidebar.when: a mini-app whose navigation lives down one side
Sidebar.not: the app's own sidebar — this one is yours, inside the page
Sidebar.distinctive: `collapsed`, `#rail`, `side`; needs a parent with a height

Skeleton.what: a placeholder shaped like what is coming
Skeleton.when: the first load of any region
Skeleton.not: a spinner over the whole page — that hides the layout the reader already had
Skeleton.distinctive: give it the size of the real thing, not a generic bar

Slideover.what: a panel over the view, from an edge
Slideover.when: the list must stay in sight — triage, compare, a quick look
Slideover.not: a rich detail someone would send by link; that is a view of its own
Slideover.distinctive: default slot is the TRIGGER, the panel is `#body`; `side`, `inset`

Slider.when: an approximate number with a known range, or a range with two handles
Slider.distinctive: `min`, `max`, `step`, an array model gives two handles

Splitter.when: two regions weighed against each other — a list and its detail
Splitter.distinctive: the parent must carry a height; `autoSaveId` saves nothing in the frame

Stepper.what: an ordered process with a current step
Stepper.when: something completed in order, where going back is legal

Switch.what: a setting that takes effect at once
Switch.when: turning something on, with no save button
Switch.not: a field inside a form the reader submits (UCheckbox)

Table.what: a data grid: sorting, selection, pinning, virtualisation
Table.when: rows compared column by column, scanned for outliers
Table.not: items with two fields and a picture (UPageList)
Table.distinctive: `#<column>-cell` slots, `@select(event, row)`, `sticky`, `:ui` REPLACES the class it names

Tabs.when: one subject seen several ways, switched instantly, no link to share
Tabs.not: views someone would bookmark or send — those are routes

Textarea.when: a value that is genuinely plain — a reason, a note nobody formats

Theme.what: a scoped colour and prop override for one subtree
Theme.when: a region that must carry its own accent without touching the page

Timeline.when: history, activity, what happened and when

Tooltip.what: a word or two on hover and focus
Tooltip.when: naming an icon-only button, expanding a truncated value
Tooltip.not: anything interactive, and never the only place a fact appears

Tree.when: the data nests — folders, categories, an org chart

User.what: avatar, name and description in one
User.when: a person anywhere — a cell, a header, a list
User.distinctive: `orientation`, `to` makes the whole block a link
